page.notes: Printed text is clear apart from a few doubtful forms; "faftigio" read as "fastigio" (Latin long s as plain s). Marginal notes: none printed. Headings: none. Line-end hyphens reconstructed as "imminere-t" in the printed "imminé-ret"; the word is split across lines as "immine-" / "ret.", so the transcription should read "immineret".
